main_text.p: Ebn O'lwalid occupata eft. Duravis hoc regnum per annos DCXXII, menses VIII.

AFRICA. N4 Elzacin.l.1. H.S.c.3.De AFRICA hoc fufficiat; Omarem per Amramum in ÆGYPTO Misram † cepisse, & muro cinctam, Fustatam nominasse. Cum Mascuaco, ejus praefecto, pacem ea lege, ut Ægypti pro fingulis perfonis aureum Ægyptiacum lul-verent, & Muslimos omnes illac transfeuntes triduum hospitio exciperent, & annuum dona decies mille aureorum tributum folverent, sese ciffe; & Alexandriam *, in cujus obfidione XXIIIM Muslimorum intra XIV menses pugnate, expugnasse.
EVROPÆAIn GERMANIA erant apud BAVAROS iidem, qui supra.

Mariana Hist. Hisp. l.6. c.3.In HISPANIA fuere fucoeffive post Gothos domarum. † Sisebutus, * Suinthila, Sisenandus † Chintila * & Tulga †. Sisebutus, latine etiam doctus, Aftures & Ruccones, qui locorum natu raconfifi rebellarant, Flavii Suinthilæ ductu, brevi domuit; ipse Romanorum reliquias furgentes, novis copiis ad veterem Sulcitanum ex-ercitum adjectis, bis vicit; & haud paucas ipso-rum ad fretum Gaditanum & Oceani littora urbes in fuam potestatem redegit: tandem et Carfarium, Patricium Romanum, pacem per Cæcilium Mentefanum Episcopum cogit. Suinthila, pater pauperum dictus, primo Valcon-nes, occasione noviimperii denuo tumultuates, & Taraconensis provinciæ fines vastavit, fuā praesentiā conterritos, deditionem facere.
Marian.l.6. c.4.compulit; & admissos in gratiam, urbem Oli-gitum fuis fumptibus aedificare coegit: deinde Rumas.

page.notes: Marginal notes are partly illegible in the scan; the left-margin notes are reconstructed approximately. Several words in the body are damaged and uncertain, notably in the lines around "Suinthila" and "Taraconensis"; the transcription there is doubtful. Right margin is cut off.
